batch.output_dir: Root directory for per-case exports. Relative paths resolve from the process working directory.
batch.skip_derived: Suppress requested WSS, TKE and pressure analysis and their exports; optional metrics otherwise remain opt-in.
batch.skip_wss: Suppress WSS only, including volume export and derived plane summaries.
batch.skip_tke: Suppress TKE only; does not manufacture TKE for unsupported inputs.
batch.skip_pressure_gradient: Suppress PG, relative-pressure reconstruction and centreline pressure-drop outputs.
batch.skip_plane_metrics: Suppress plane metric calculation and its JSON/H5 exports. PWV also needs plane metrics.
batch.use_multithread: Enable process plane metrics with memory-mapped inputs: below 128 planes, use four workers only at 1920 or more plane-phase evaluations; smaller jobs stay serial. At least 128 planes use up to eight workers. CPU/plane counts cap workers.
batch.reuse_planes: Path to a plane-position JSON or per-case directory to reuse. Empty string generates planes normally.

ui.background_color: Background colour of the 3D scene, as a VTK colour name or hexadecimal RGB. Changes display only.

loader.background_phase_correction.enabled: Enable correction of static-tissue velocity offsets during loading. A compatible embedded correction may be reused unless force_recompute is true.
loader.background_phase_correction.method: Correction backend: wrls_arto uses robust weighted regression with automatic rejection; msac uses polynomial sample consensus.
loader.background_phase_correction.corr_fit_ord: Polynomial order for MSAC correction. Higher orders add spatial flexibility and fitting cost; not the WRLS fixed basis order.
loader.background_phase_correction.threshold: MSAC residual threshold as a fraction of VENC; controls static-tissue inlier acceptance.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_lambda: L1 penalty on WRLS polynomial coefficients; larger values impose stronger regularization.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_magnitu: Minimum reference-magnitude fraction for the static-tissue fitting mask; low-signal voxels are discarded.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_mid_fov: Fraction of the two in-plane axes used for the central fitting region; restricts initial static-tissue support.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_mid_sli: Fraction of the slice axis retained for the central fitting region.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_arto_it: Number of automatic rejection/refitting rounds after the initial WRLS estimate.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_tau: Residual acceptance width in multiples of the fitted central Gaussian standard deviation.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_delta: Initial separation of the outer ARTO Gaussian means from zero, in residual standard deviations.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_central: Prior/minimum mixture probability for the static-tissue central Gaussian; lies between zero and one.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_fista_i: Maximum iterations of the sparse WRLS coefficient solver; increases fitting work without changing polynomial degree.
loader.background_phase_correction.wrls_gmm_ite: Maximum EM iterations per ARTO Gaussian-mixture fit; early convergence may stop sooner.
loader.background_phase_correction.dual_venc_ra: Dual-VENC decision threshold used in the 2*LV alias-shift stage. Zero derives the threshold from high/low VENC.
Dual-VENC decision threshold used in the 4*LV alias-shift stage. Zero derives the threshold from high/low VENC.
loader.background_phase_correction.force_recomp: Ignore reusable embedded correction and estimate a fresh field; needed for a cold algorithm benchmark.
loader.background_phase_correction.write_cache: Allow newly computed correction to be stored in the source H5. Set false for read-only measurements.
loader.dicom_parameter_overrides: Object of explicit DICOM metadata replacements; see the supported keys and units in the input contract. Does not rewrite DICOM files.
loader.dicom_read_workers: Number of concurrent DICOM file readers. One is conservative for network storage; more readers can increase I/O contention.
loader.ignore_embedded_segmentation: Ignore source H5 segmentation while retaining image/velocity input; use to test a fresh segmentation path.
loader.dicom_backend: DICOM directory route: native loads recognized cases directly; dicom2h5 converts through the optional pinned converter and processes all resulting H5 groups. Explicit H5 files are unaffected.
loader.dicom_h5_dir: Destination directory for preserved Dicom2H5 outputs. Empty uses output_dir/_dicom_h5. Existing files cause an error; reopen the saved H5 to reuse it.

phase_unwrapping.mask_source: Learned-backend support/confidence: segmask uses segmentation; pcmra_std uses temporal PC-MRA standard deviation for weighting and Gaussian-centre confidence.
phase_unwrapping.device: Compute device selector: auto, cpu, or cuda. Backend-specific CPU work can remain even with cuda selected.
phase_unwrapping.tfc: Temporal flow consistency option of supported traditional methods; couples recovery across cardiac phases.
phase_unwrapping.lap4d_ts: Temporal-axis scaling in the lap4D Laplacian operator; controls the balance of temporal and spatial constraints.
phase_unwrapping.nprs_upsampling_factor: Spatial Fourier upsampling factor used only by NPRS; larger factors increase memory and resampling cost.
phase_unwrapping.nprs_pi_unwrap: Enable the additional pi-unwrapping pass of NPRS.
phase_unwrapping.nprs_auto_crop: Return NPRS output cropped to the original array extent after FFT padding.
phase_unwrapping.backend_params: Backend-specific nested objects, e.g. pudip and gust; supported adapter keys are listed below rather than passed blindly.
phase_unwrapping.write_output: Write phase_unwrap.npz when phase recovery runs; has no effect when the method is disabled or DV input skips recovery.

skeleton.remove_small_cc: Filter small connected components before skeletonization.
skeleton.special_handling: Special systemic-branch strategy: three_pass_merge separates and merges branch skeleton passes; other supported modes are described in the skeleton guide.
skeleton.special_merge_radius_mm: Maximum physical distance in mm for joining the special-handling skeleton passes.
skeleton.separate_special_label_contacts: Separate configured special labels where they touch before skeleton generation.
skeleton.special_contact_labels: Anatomical label names subject to the contact-separation rule; resolve IDs through labels.label_map.
skeleton.min_cc_volume_mm3: Absolute connected-component volume threshold in cubic millimetres.
skeleton.cc_filter_mode: Component retention rule: absolute, relative or hybrid combines physical volume and a fraction of the largest component.
skeleton.cc_rel_min_ratio: Smallest retained component as a fraction of the largest component in relative/hybrid filtering.
skeleton.min_edge_points: Minimum graph-edge point count retained during graph cleanup; controls short terminal-edge removal.
skeleton.do_closing: Legacy Boolean binary-closing switch used in default preprocessing.
skeleton.do_opening: Legacy Boolean binary-opening switch used in default preprocessing.
skeleton.gaussian_sigma: Gaussian mask smoothing width in voxels before binary thresholding.
skeleton.gaussian_enabled: Enable Gaussian mask smoothing; per-group overrides in labels.label_groups can replace this value.
skeleton.dilation_iters: Number of binary dilation iterations; expands support and can connect nearby vessels. Zero disables this operation.
skeleton.erosion_iters: Number of binary erosion iterations; shrinks support and can remove narrow structures.
skeleton.opening_iters: Number of explicit binary opening iterations; removes small protrusions/components.
skeleton.closing_iters: Number of explicit binary closing iterations; fills small gaps and holes.

labels.single_label_group_name: Group name for a binary/single-label input in the GUI browser and grouped analysis.
labels.single_label_browser_color: Display colour for the single-label group.
labels.default_group_browser_color: Fallback colour for a group without an explicit colour.
labels.label_map: Dictionary from anatomical label names to integer IDs; background is zero. The configured mapping must match the segmentation/model.
labels.label_groups: Named group definitions containing member labels, colours and optional preprocessing overrides; each group is processed independently.

planes.plane_mode: Placement rule: count, distance, anchored_offset, uniform or fixed_step. Controls which spacing/anchor parameters are active.
planes.plane_count: Number of planes in count/fixed-step placement; -1 requests all available valid locations where supported.
planes.cross_section_distance: Physical separation in mm used by distance/fixed-step layouts.
planes.start_distance: Millimetres trimmed from the start of each usable path before plane placement.
planes.end_distance: Millimetres trimmed from the end of each usable path before plane placement.
planes.anchor: Reference location: start, center, end or junction. Defines the origin for anchored placement.
planes.anchor_offset_mm: Physical offset in mm from the selected anchor toward the chosen direction.
planes.direction: Placement direction from the anchor: toward_start, toward_end or both.
planes.spacing_mode: Anchor-layout spacing interpretation: distance in mm or fraction of usable path length.
planes.spacing_ratio: Dimensionless usable-path-length fraction between anchored planes when spacing_mode=fraction.
planes.segmentation_filter: Discard candidate planes whose centreline location lacks compatible segmentation support.
planes.smoothing_window: Savitzky-Golay window length for centreline smoothing; must admit the selected polynomial order.
planes.smoothing_polyorder: Polynomial degree of centreline Savitzky-Golay smoothing.
planes.inter_time: Centreline interpolation density multiplier; increases resampled path points before plane generation.

streamlines.seed_ratio: Fraction of slice support locations sampled as streamline seeds; min_seeds sets a lower target when possible.
streamlines.max_steps: Maximum integration steps for each instantaneous streamline.
streamlines.min_seeds: Minimum desired seed count per valid plane, limited by available support.
streamlines.terminal_speed: Velocity threshold in m/s for terminating streamline integration (input cm/s is converted to m/s).
streamlines.rng_seed: Random seed for reproducible seed subsampling.
streamlines.tube_radius: Rendered tube radius in physical mm; affects display geometry, not integration.

pathlines.seed_ratio: Support fraction used only by ratio seeding.
pathlines.max_steps: Maximum temporal integration steps per pathline.
pathlines.min_seeds: Minimum desired seed count in ratio mode.
pathlines.seed_mode: fixed uses seed_count; ratio uses seed_ratio and min_seeds.
pathlines.seed_count: Maximum desired seeds per plane in fixed mode; support limits the actual count.
pathlines.terminal_speed: Velocity threshold in m/s for terminating temporal integration; the VTK temporal source uses mm/s and converts this threshold.
pathlines.rng_seed: Random seed for reproducible pathline seed placement.
pathlines.tube_radius: Rendered pathline tube radius in mm.
pathlines.color_mode: uniform, per_plane or per_group colour assignment; affects display only.
pathlines.temporal_cache_mb: Memory limit in MiB for prepared temporal velocity grids; larger limits can accelerate repeated GUI phase changes.

fluid.rho: Blood density in kg/m^3, shared by pressure and TKE unless their module overrides it.
fluid.viscosity: Dynamic viscosity in mPa*s, shared by WSS and pressure unless their module overrides it.

wss.smoothing_iteration: Taubin surface-smoothing iterations before normal sampling; zero retains the extracted voxel surface.
wss.inward_distance: Wall-normal sampling step h in mm; auto uses the minimum voxel spacing. Parabolic fitting also probes 2h.
wss.parabolic_fitting: True computes the exact wall derivative of a three-point quadratic vector fit; false uses the first-segment linear slope.
wss.no_slip_condition: Set the wall velocity vector to zero by default. False samples the measured wall vector and increases sensitivity to partial volume and surface placement.

tke.rho: Optional TKE density override in kg/m^3; absent uses fluid.rho.

pressure_gradient.rho: Optional pressure density override in kg/m^3; absent uses fluid.rho.
pressure_gradient.viscosity: Optional pressure viscosity override in mPa*s; absent uses fluid.viscosity.
pressure_gradient.method: Relative-pressure reconstruction: least_squares integrates face-averaged PG; ppe balances finite-volume gradient fluxes. Their Cartesian discrete equations are equivalent.
pressure_gradient.smoothing_sigma: Spatial Gaussian smoothing width in voxels. Zero disables smoothing; valid-mask normalization prevents boundary attenuation.
pressure_gradient.support_erosion_iters: Additional conservative 26-neighbour erosion margin. Complete measured spatial and temporal derivative stencils are mandatory even at zero.
pressure_gradient.layer_opacity: PG layer opacity between zero (transparent) and one (opaque), affecting display only.
pressure_gradient.relative_pressure_opacity: Relative-pressure layer opacity between zero and one.
pressure_gradient.use_convective_acceleration: Include (v dot grad)v in Navier-Stokes PG. Disabling omits real convective effects and is an explicit approximation.

vortex.smoothing_sigma: Spatial Gaussian velocity smoothing width in voxels before vortex derivatives; zero disables smoothing.
vortex.support_erosion_iters: Lumen-mask erosion iterations defining valid vortex derivative support. Zero disables the optional erosion.

pwv.enabled: Enable the configured PWV workflow; CLI/API must still request pwv as an optional metric.
pwv.groups: List of PWV group objects: name identifies the result; labels selects the anatomical members.
pwv.plane_interval_mm: Physical separation in mm between PWV sampling planes.
pwv.start_distance: Millimetres trimmed from the path start for PWV plane placement.
pwv.end_distance: Millimetres trimmed from the path end for PWV plane placement.
pwv.smoothing_window: Savitzky-Golay centreline-smoothing window length for PWV plane generation.
pwv.smoothing_polyorder: Polynomial degree for PWV centreline smoothing.
pwv.inter_time: Centreline interpolation density for PWV distance sampling.
pwv.waveform_key: Time-resolved plane metric used as the propagation waveform, e.g. flowrate_mL_s.
pwv.transit_time_method: Delay estimator: foot_to_foot uses waveform feet; supported cross-correlation mode aligns complete waveforms.
pwv.foot_method: Foot detector, such as tangent or threshold; applies to foot_to_foot delay estimation.
pwv.foot_savgol_window: Odd smoothing window in cardiac samples used before waveform-foot detection.
pwv.foot_savgol_polyorder: Polynomial degree of foot-detection waveform smoothing.
pwv.foot_threshold_percent: Percentage of the waveform upstroke range used by threshold foot detection.
pwv.xcorr_window: Waveform window used for cross-correlation; full uses the complete sampled cycle.
pwv.xcorr_interp_factor: Sub-frame temporal interpolation multiplier for cross-correlation lag resolution.
pwv.allow_cycle_wrap: Allow propagation delays across the end/start boundary of the cardiac cycle.
pwv.minimum_valid_planes: Minimum successfully sampled planes needed to fit distance against arrival time.
pwv.scene_visible: Initial GUI visibility of the generated PWV planes.
pwv.fit_color: Colour of the fitted PWV regression line.
pwv.plot_dpi: Resolution in dots per inch of exported PWV plots.

segmentation.visible: Initial visibility of segmentation surfaces in the 3D scene.
segmentation.opacity: Segmentation surface opacity between zero and one.
segmentation.active_label: Integer label painted or modified by the editor.
segmentation.editing_enabled: Initial enable state of segmentation editing; enables correction controls.
segmentation.tool: Editor tool selector, e.g. brush; controls how mouse edits modify the active mask.
segmentation.brush_radius: Brush radius in voxel/pixel units of the editing slice.
segmentation.edit_all_timepoints: Apply a mask edit across all cardiac phases instead of the current phase only.
segmentation.cleanup_4d_components: Enable connected-component cleanup of the 4D segmentation.
segmentation.cleanup_4d_mode: Component cleanup policy; absolute uses a physical-volume threshold.
segmentation.cleanup_4d_min_volume_mm3: Minimum physical component volume in mm^3 for configured 4D cleanup.
segmentation.mode: Segmentation workflow mode: use input, import an external mask, threshold scalar data, or run the automatic backend.
segmentation.input_source: Choose which already loaded segmentation source becomes active; original refers to embedded input segmentation.
segmentation.import_path: External H5/NPY/NPZ/NIfTI segmentation path; empty leaves import unconfigured.
segmentation.threshold_scalar: Scalar field thresholded to create a mask, such as pcmra, mag or velocity magnitude.
segmentation.threshold_value.mode: manual uses explicit scalar-range percentages; supported automatic modes choose thresholds from the image.
segmentation.threshold_value.min_percent: Lower cutoff as a percentage of the selected scalar range.
segmentation.threshold_value.max_percent: Upper cutoff as a percentage of the selected scalar range.
segmentation.threshold_keep_largest_cc: Keep only the largest threshold-derived connected component when enabled.
segmentation.threshold_min_component_volume_mm3: Remove threshold-derived components below this physical volume in mm^3.
segmentation.threshold_closing: Apply binary closing to the threshold-derived mask.
segmentation.threshold_opening: Apply binary opening to the threshold-derived mask.
segmentation.auto_backend: Automatic backend: nnUNet4D predicts phase-resolved temporal masks; nnUNet predicts a static mask copied over phases.
segmentation.auto_model: Model directory or auto profile. Auto resolves the backend-specific Dataset7020 temporal or Dataset7010 static model.
segmentation.auto_checkpoint: Checkpoint basename or auto. Auto chooses the profile's checkpoint; does not download a model.
segmentation.auto_folds: single selects fold_all or the first available fold; all selects all numeric folds when available; a comma list selects explicit folds.
segmentation.auto_device: Inference device: auto selects CUDA when available, otherwise CPU.
segmentation.auto_label_map: Optional file/string label mapping used to interpret automatic model output.
segmentation.force_recompute_auto_cache: Ignore previous automatic-segmentation artifacts and produce a new prediction.
segmentation.write_auto_cache: Permit segmentation-cache writes into supported source H5 files. Set false for read-only benchmarking.

colorbar.show: Default shared GUI scalar-bar visibility; metric visibility still follows its active layer.

video_exporting.fps: Output video frame rate in frames per second; sets playback speed independently of acquired RR.
video_exporting.plane_rotation_frames: Number of camera-rotation frames in the plane video.
video_exporting.make_plane_video: Request a plane video without requiring a separate requested_videos entry.
video_exporting.make_wss_video: Request WSS computation/rendering and a WSS video.
video_exporting.make_pressure_gradient_video: Request pressure computation and PG/relative-pressure videos.
video_exporting.make_tke_video: Request the TKE video when supported input TKE exists.
video_exporting.camera_view: Initial camera direction, such as right; controls exported viewing orientation.
video_exporting.camera_distance_scale: Multiplier of scene-based camera distance; larger values make the vessel appear smaller.
video_exporting.rotate_dynamic_video: Rotate the camera during dynamic metric videos; false retains a fixed view.
video_exporting.dynamic_rotation_frames: Frames for one dynamic camera rotation cycle.
video_exporting.dynamic_rotation_elevation_deg: Elevation in degrees for the dynamic camera orbit; null uses the renderer's standard setting.
video_exporting.dynamic_time_repeat: Number of cardiac playback repeats within the dynamic export.
video_exporting.add_plane_idx: Annotate the plane index in plane-video labels.
video_exporting.add_path_idx: Annotate the owning path index in plane-video labels.
video_exporting.window_size: Render canvas [width,height] in pixels; larger dimensions increase rendering and encoding cost.
video_exporting.plane_video.show_skeleton: Show the skeleton in plane videos.
video_exporting.plane_video.label.prefix: Text prepended to each plane-video label.
video_exporting.plane_video.label.shape_color: Background/outline colour of the plane-label shape.
video_exporting.plane_video.label.shape_opacity: Opacity of the plane-label shape between zero and one.
video_exporting.plane_video.default.skeleton_color: Skeleton-colour override for plane videos; empty uses the group/default scene colour.
video_exporting.plane_video.default.plane_size: Physical side length in mm of the displayed plane square.
video_exporting.plane_video.default.plane_color: Plane-video default colour; group settings can override it.
video_exporting.plane_video.default.plane_opacity: Default plane-video opacity between zero and one.
video_exporting.plane_video.groups: Per-group plane-video overrides; each group may supply skeleton_color, plane_size, plane_color and plane_opacity.

render.clim: Displayed scalar limits [lower,upper] in the metric's units; null selects the automatic range. Changes colours only, never numerical results.
render.show_scalar_bar: Show the metric scalar bar in the GUI/offline renderer.
render.relative_pressure_clim: Displayed relative-pressure range [lower,upper] in Pa; null uses an automatic symmetric range.
render.position_x: Horizontal scalar-bar origin as a viewport fraction between zero and one.
render.position_y: Vertical scalar-bar origin as a viewport fraction between zero and one.
render.height: Scalar-bar height as a viewport fraction.
render.width: Scalar-bar width as a viewport fraction.
render.title_font_size: Scalar-bar title font size in points.
render.label_font_size: Scalar-bar tick-label font size in points.
render.plane_color: Plane display colour for the default or named anatomical group.
render.plane_opacity: Plane display opacity between zero and one for the default or named anatomical group.

inputs.effect: H5/HDF5 or DICOM files/directories to discover. H5 directory discovery is top-level; nested H5 case groups become separate cases.

config_dir.effect: Directory containing module JSON defaults. None resolves installed/repository defaults; explicit AutoFlowConfig fields override bundle-mapped fields.

output_dir.effect: Root directory for per-case exports. Relative paths resolve from the process working directory.

skip_derived.effect: Suppress requested WSS, TKE and pressure analysis and their exports; optional metrics otherwise remain opt-in.

skip_wss.effect: Suppress WSS only, including volume export and derived plane summaries.

skip_tke.effect: Suppress TKE only; does not manufacture TKE for unsupported inputs.

skip_pressure_gradient.effect: Suppress PG, relative-pressure reconstruction and centreline pressure-drop outputs.

skip_plane_metrics.effect: Suppress plane metric calculation and its JSON/H5 exports. PWV also needs plane metrics.

use_multithread.effect: Enable process plane metrics with memory-mapped inputs: below 128 planes, use four workers only at 1920 or more plane-phase evaluations; smaller jobs stay serial. At least 128 planes use up to eight workers. CPU/plane counts cap workers.

reuse_planes.effect: Path to a plane-position JSON or per-case directory to reuse. Empty string generates planes normally.

plane_import_mode.effect: Coordinate interpretation for imported planes: world (canonical world mm), local (local physical mm), or path_relative (fractional centreline position).

export_planes.effect: Additional plane-position JSON path; empty disables this extra copy. Use a directory for a multi-case batch.

background_phase_correction.effect: Enable correction of static-tissue velocity offsets during loading. A compatible embedded correction may be reused unless force_recompute is true.

background_phase_method.effect: Correction backend: wrls_arto uses robust weighted regression with automatic rejection; msac uses polynomial sample consensus.

background_phase_corr_fit_order.effect: Polynomial order for MSAC correction. Higher orders add spatial flexibility and fitting cost; not the WRLS fixed basis order.

background_phase_threshold.effect: MSAC residual threshold as a fraction of VENC; controls static-tissue inlier acceptance.

background_phase_wrls_lambda.effect: L1 penalty on WRLS polynomial coefficients; larger values impose stronger regularization.

background_phase_wrls_magnitude_threshol.effect: Minimum reference-magnitude fraction for the static-tissue fitting mask; low-signal voxels are discarded.

background_phase_wrls_mid_fov_fraction.effect: Fraction of the two in-plane axes used for the central fitting region; restricts initial static-tissue support.

background_phase_wrls_mid_slice_fraction.effect: Fraction of the slice axis retained for the central fitting region.

background_phase_wrls_arto_iterations.effect: Number of automatic rejection/refitting rounds after the initial WRLS estimate.

background_phase_wrls_tau.effect: Residual acceptance width in multiples of the fitted central Gaussian standard deviation.

background_phase_wrls_delta.effect: Initial separation of the outer ARTO Gaussian means from zero, in residual standard deviations.

background_phase_wrls_central_probabilit.effect: Prior/minimum mixture probability for the static-tissue central Gaussian; lies between zero and one.

background_phase_wrls_fista_iterations.effect: Maximum iterations of the sparse WRLS coefficient solver; increases fitting work without changing polynomial degree.

background_phase_wrls_gmm_iterations.effect: Maximum EM iterations per ARTO Gaussian-mixture fit; early convergence may stop sooner.

dual_venc_ratio1.effect: Dual-VENC decision threshold used in the 2*LV alias-shift stage. Zero derives the threshold from high/low VENC.

dual_venc_ratio2.effect: Dual-VENC decision threshold used in the 4*LV alias-shift stage. Zero derives the threshold from high/low VENC.

force_recompute_corr.effect: Ignore reusable embedded correction and estimate a fresh field; needed for a cold algorithm benchmark.

background_phase_write_cache.effect: Allow newly computed correction to be stored in the source H5. Set false for read-only measurements.

dicom_read_workers.effect: Number of concurrent DICOM file readers. One is conservative for network storage; more readers can increase I/O contention.

ignore_embedded_segmentation.effect: Ignore source H5 segmentation while retaining image/velocity input; use to test a fresh segmentation path.

phase_unwrap_enabled.effect: Legacy enable switch. Selecting a nonempty phase_unwrap_method is the public opt-in action; leave method none to skip.

phase_unwrap_method.effect: Select none, gc3D, lap4D, nprs, pudip or gust. A selected method opts in; DV dual-VENC inputs skip this step.

phase_unwrap_mask.effect: Learned-backend support/confidence: segmask uses segmentation; pcmra_std uses temporal PC-MRA standard deviation for weighting and Gaussian-centre confidence.

phase_unwrap_device.effect: Compute device selector: auto, cpu, or cuda. Backend-specific CPU work can remain even with cuda selected.

phase_unwrap_tfc.effect: Temporal flow consistency option of supported traditional methods; couples recovery across cardiac phases.

phase_unwrap_lap4d_ts.effect: Temporal-axis scaling in the lap4D Laplacian operator; controls the balance of temporal and spatial constraints.

phase_unwrap_nprs_upsampling_factor.effect: Spatial Fourier upsampling factor used only by NPRS; larger factors increase memory and resampling cost.

phase_unwrap_nprs_pi_unwrap.effect: Enable the additional pi-unwrapping pass of NPRS.

phase_unwrap_nprs_auto_crop.effect: Return NPRS output cropped to the original array extent after FFT padding.

plane_mode.effect: Placement rule: count, distance, anchored_offset, uniform or fixed_step. Controls which spacing/anchor parameters are active.

plane_count.effect: Number of planes in count/fixed-step placement; -1 requests all available valid locations where supported.

cross_section_dist.effect: Physical separation in mm used by distance/fixed-step layouts.

start_dist.effect: Millimetres trimmed from the start of each usable path before plane placement.

end_dist.effect: Millimetres trimmed from the end of each usable path before plane placement.

plane_anchor.effect: Reference location: start, center, end or junction. Defines the origin for anchored placement.

plane_offset_mm.effect: Physical offset in mm from the selected anchor toward the chosen direction.

plane_direction.effect: Placement direction from the anchor: toward_start, toward_end or both.

plane_spacing_mode.effect: Anchor-layout spacing interpretation: distance in mm or fraction of usable path length.

plane_spacing_ratio.effect: Dimensionless usable-path-length fraction between anchored planes when spacing_mode=fraction.

segmentation_filter.effect: Discard candidate planes whose centreline location lacks compatible segmentation support.

use_center_plane.effect: Legacy centre-plane override for older layouts; None leaves the configured layout unchanged. Prefer fixed_step anchor/direction/spacing controls.

remove_small_cc.effect: Filter small connected components before skeletonization.

special_handling.effect: Special systemic-branch strategy: three_pass_merge separates and merges branch skeleton passes; other supported modes are described in the skeleton guide.

special_merge_radius_mm.effect: Maximum physical distance in mm for joining the special-handling skeleton passes.

separate_special_label_contacts.effect: Separate configured special labels where they touch before skeleton generation.

special_contact_labels.effect: Anatomical label names subject to the contact-separation rule; resolve IDs through labels.label_map.

min_cc_volume.effect: Absolute connected-component volume threshold in cubic millimetres.

cc_filter_mode.effect: Component retention rule: absolute, relative or hybrid combines physical volume and a fraction of the largest component.

cc_rel_min_ratio.effect: Smallest retained component as a fraction of the largest component in relative/hybrid filtering.

min_edge_points.effect: Minimum graph-edge point count retained during graph cleanup; controls short terminal-edge removal.

seed_ratio.effect: Fraction of slice support locations sampled as streamline seeds; min_seeds sets a lower target when possible.

max_steps.effect: Maximum integration steps for each instantaneous streamline.

min_seeds.effect: Minimum desired seed count per valid plane, limited by available support.

pathline_seed_ratio.effect: Support fraction used only by ratio seeding.

pathline_max_steps.effect: Maximum temporal integration steps per pathline.

pathline_min_seeds.effect: Minimum desired seed count in ratio mode.

pathline_seed_mode.effect: fixed uses seed_count; ratio uses seed_ratio and min_seeds.

pathline_max_seeds.effect: Maximum desired seeds per plane in fixed mode; support limits the actual count.

pathline_terminal_speed.effect: Velocity threshold in m/s for terminating temporal integration; the VTK temporal source uses mm/s and converts this threshold.

pathline_rng_seed.effect: Random seed for reproducible pathline seed placement.

pathline_tube_radius.effect: Rendered pathline tube radius in mm.

terminal_speed.effect: Velocity threshold in m/s for terminating streamline integration (input cm/s is converted to m/s).

rng_seed.effect: Random seed for reproducible seed subsampling.

tube_radius.effect: Rendered tube radius in physical mm; affects display geometry, not integration.

plane_pathline_color.effect: Compatibility alias for the uniform pathline colour. Prefer pathline_color; affects GUI display only.

pathline_color_mode.effect: uniform, per_plane or per_group colour assignment; affects display only.

pathline_temporal_cache_mb.effect: Memory limit in MiB for prepared temporal velocity grids; larger limits can accelerate repeated GUI phase changes.

pressure_method.effect: Relative-pressure reconstruction: least_squares integrates face-averaged PG; ppe balances finite-volume gradient fluxes. Their Cartesian discrete equations are equivalent.

autoseg.effect: Run the selected automatic backend when a segmentation is needed; false requires an embedded or imported segmentation.

autoseg_backend.effect: Automatic backend: nnUNet4D predicts phase-resolved temporal masks; nnUNet predicts a static mask copied over phases.

autoseg_model.effect: Model directory or auto profile. Auto resolves the backend-specific Dataset7020 temporal or Dataset7010 static model.

autoseg_checkpoint.effect: Checkpoint basename or auto. Auto chooses the profile's checkpoint; does not download a model.

autoseg_folds.effect: single selects fold_all or the first available fold; all selects all numeric folds when available; a comma list selects explicit folds.

autoseg_device.effect: Inference device: auto selects CUDA when available, otherwise CPU.

autoseg_label_map.effect: Optional file/string label mapping used to interpret automatic model output.

force_recompute_seg.effect: Ignore previous automatic-segmentation artifacts and produce a new prediction.

write_segmentation_cache.effect: Permit segmentation-cache writes into supported source H5 files. Set false for read-only benchmarking.

segmentation_only.effect: Load and generate/export segmentation, then stop before skeleton, planes and metrics.

requested_metrics.effect: Opt-in family names: pwv, wss, tke, pg, vortex. Empty requests only basic plane metrics; skip flags take priority. TKE is skipped cleanly when unavailable.

requested_videos.effect: Opt-in video names: plane, wss, tke, pg, streamlines. Empty produces no videos. Requested metric videos may require the corresponding numerical family.

fps.effect: Output video frame rate in frames per second; sets playback speed independently of acquired RR.

plane_rotation_frames.effect: Number of camera-rotation frames in the plane video.

make_plane_video.effect: Request a plane video without requiring a separate requested_videos entry.

make_wss_video.effect: Request WSS computation/rendering and a WSS video.

make_pressure_gradient_video.effect: Request pressure computation and PG/relative-pressure videos.

make_tke_video.effect: Request the TKE video when supported input TKE exists.

camera_view.effect: Initial camera direction, such as right; controls exported viewing orientation.

camera_distance_scale.effect: Multiplier of scene-based camera distance; larger values make the vessel appear smaller.

rotate_dynamic_video.effect: Rotate the camera during dynamic metric videos; false retains a fixed view.

dynamic_rotation_frames.effect: Frames for one dynamic camera rotation cycle.

dynamic_rotation_elevation_deg.effect: Elevation in degrees for the dynamic camera orbit; null uses the renderer's standard setting.

dynamic_time_repeat.effect: Number of cardiac playback repeats within the dynamic export.

add_plane_idx.effect: Annotate the plane index in plane-video labels.

add_path_idx.effect: Annotate the owning path index in plane-video labels.

plane_video_cfg.effect: Nested plane-video skeleton, label and per-group styles; see every field in video_exporting.

window_size.effect: Render canvas [width,height] in pixels; larger dimensions increase rendering and encoding cost.

shared_colorbar_show.effect: Default shared GUI scalar-bar visibility; metric visibility still follows its active layer.

shared_colorbar_bar_cfg.effect: Colourbar geometry and fonts as a mapping. Nested fields are documented under colorbar in the configuration reference.

wss_clim.effect: Displayed scalar limits [lower,upper] in the metric's units; null selects the automatic range. Changes colours only, never numerical results.

wss_show_scalar_bar.effect: Show the metric scalar bar in the GUI/offline renderer.

wss_bar_cfg.effect: Colourbar geometry and fonts as a mapping. Nested fields are documented under wss in the configuration reference.

tke_clim.effect: Displayed scalar limits [lower,upper] in the metric's units; null selects the automatic range. Changes colours only, never numerical results.

tke_show_scalar_bar.effect: Show the metric scalar bar in the GUI/offline renderer.

tke_bar_cfg.effect: Colourbar geometry and fonts as a mapping. Nested fields are documented under tke in the configuration reference.

pressure_gradient_clim.effect: Displayed scalar limits [lower,upper] in the metric's units; null selects the automatic range. Changes colours only, never numerical results.

pressure_gradient_show_scalar_bar.effect: Show the metric scalar bar in the GUI/offline renderer.

pressure_gradient_bar_cfg.effect: Colourbar geometry and fonts as a mapping. Nested fields are documented under pressure_gradient in the configuration reference.

relative_pressure_clim.effect: Displayed relative-pressure range [lower,upper] in Pa; null uses an automatic symmetric range.

relative_pressure_bar_cfg.effect: Colourbar geometry and fonts as a mapping. Nested fields are documented under pressure_gradient in the configuration reference.

streamline_clim.effect: Displayed scalar limits [lower,upper] in the metric's units; null selects the automatic range. Changes colours only, never numerical results.

streamline_show_scalar_bar.effect: Show the metric scalar bar in the GUI/offline renderer.

streamline_bar_cfg.effect: Colourbar geometry and fonts as a mapping. Nested fields are documented under streamlines in the configuration reference.

phase_unwrap_backend_params.effect: Backend-specific nested objects, e.g. pudip and gust; supported adapter keys are listed below rather than passed blindly.

dicom_backend.effect: DICOM directory route: native loads recognized cases directly; dicom2h5 converts through the optional pinned converter and processes all resulting H5 groups. Explicit H5 files are unaffected.

dicom_h5_dir.effect: Destination directory for preserved Dicom2H5 outputs. Empty uses output_dir/_dicom_h5. Existing files cause an error; reopen the saved H5 to reuse it.
